description:
Signed usage checkpoint (§17.3), signed with a `recovery` purpose key. The
agent verifies the signature, purpose, node and incarnation binding and the
recovery record before accepting a watermark lower than a previous ACK.
Within one ledger_epoch the ACK never goes backwards; only a new verified
ledger_epoch starts a new baseline.
